title: River boat trip with the Kansas City Rockets and Jesse Stone
summary: He rejoined Thamon Hayes and played dances on a boat down the Missouri and up the Illinois to Peoria, with Jesse Stone arranging.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: They were from Indianapolis I think. Yeah, most of them. So after that I went back to Kansas City with Damon Hayes (PHONETIC). And it was called Damon Hayes and the Kansas City Rockets by then you know. And we took a boat down the Missouri River, down to St. Louis and came up the Illinois River up to Galesburg, Illinois.
To Peoria and we docked there for about two or three weeks.

Every night we was playing on this boat and you know we stopped at each town every night and give a dance right on the boat -- the boat ride -- you know. On the trip down to Missouri and up to Illinois.

And every night we had a -- we had a swell arranger on that band -- in that band too, named Jessfe Stone (PHONETIC). And Jessfe Stone was way ahead of everybody really. He was a very great arranger and a piano player. In fact he was an all around good musician.

You know -- and I guess he's still living -- I think he is. And I got a wire from Blanche Calloway (PHONETIC)- to join her in Memphis. So I -- things looked kinda slow for the band -- you know. We wasn't getting much money on this boat thing you know.
Getting bored and (inaudible) as you would call it on a boat. You know -- but it wasn't really -- you know -- but anyway, --
